title: Beginner Pottery & Coffee Night
description: A guided wheel-throwing session for complete beginners. Everyone starts at the same place, hands stay busy, and the second half is coffee and easy conversation around the tables.
format: Guided 60-min beginner session, then 45 min open conversation
intendedSocialExperience: Low-pressure first meeting: shared beginner status, hands busy, no need to fill silences
whySuggested: People nearby who opted into community demand share an interest in creative activities and are free on Thursday evenings. Your studio hosts creative events, has wheels and a kiln, and is open Thursday until 21:00.
assumptionsToValidate: Studio has 8 wheels available that evening
Clay and glaze cost is covered by the ticket price
